installation.coverage: Prescribed assembly order and sampled rigid paths; foam compression, wires, real tools excluded.

hardware_motion.coverage: Screws/washers/nuts/inserts/bearings against stationary printed parts and servo cases. Threads intentional.

results.note: 25T source profile with a split interrupting one sector. Not 25 equally loaded teeth; contact angles exclude clamp deformation/FDM error.
25T source profile with a split interrupting one sector. Not 25 equally loaded teeth; contact angles exclude clamp deformation/FDM error.

print_pose.coverage: Actual exported print poses, bed faces and 3MF dimensions. Downward faces may be bridges/supports; no slicer/G-code run.

axial_stops.coverage: CAD positive shaft-tip stops engage before journal can rub stationary servo boss; real tightening and FDM still untested.

results.check: One shared outer-adapter print file, three instances

bearing_interfaces.coordinate_frame: Exported assembly meshes, Z-up; Pan axis +Z; Tilt bearing insertion +X
bearing_interfaces.method: Manifold boolean void/material probes on exported float32 STL; 0.05mm3 rejection threshold; probes offset 0.01-0.02mm from nominal surfaces
bearing_interfaces.limitations: Local radial wall rings are not a global wall-thickness or strength certification. Actual unknown-brand ring/seal contact and FDM fits remain untested.

pan_detachable_key.limitation: New detachable keyed joint; axial bolt and clamp do not establish measured zero backlash or torque capacity. Physical trial is required.

axial_design.note: 用夹紧套消除明显窜动，保留自由转动，不给轴承施加强预紧；未实测

physical_validation: Not printed, not load tested. No rated stall-torque or precision claim.
